bottom_line: Public marketing claims are largely backed by real product surfaces and substantial client/engine code. The competitive risk remains data depth and operational quality: recipe_ingredients is empty, substitution coverage is ~42 curated edges, aliases are thin (110), Wikidata QIDs are absent, creator_profiles is empty, and substitution feedback analytics are defined but not wired in the UI.
